Prayer Request for Pastor Tyler Shores 10/1/2026:

Pastor Tyler is a local Pastor who is starting up a young adults group looking to revive evangelism in his church. 

Please keep him in your prayers so that the Lord may work in their church to rise up young adults, zealous and reverent for the Holy Spirit to do the work that is required.

Pray for me too, just got back from my vacation and I feel my flesh bubbling up with slight bit of anxiety I think maybe about my future or something or maybe just I’m not liking that I’m back and all my responsibilities are coming back 😅😂 but I’m not sure exactly what it’s from so pray that I get discernment and also just not allow the feeling to effect me.
Come to ICC prayer night

Prayer Request for Woodway Young Adults 10/1/2026:

For some of you that do not know, I record content for our ministry for our scripture reading and I came to this park in woodway, WA where I was planning to film one of the scriptures that we are covering. There is five young adults or teenagers that were sitting at a table cursing and just talking nonsense. So the Holy Spirit prompted me to come up to them and on the third try of the Holy Spirit nudging me. I finally gave in and grabbed some Bibles and I walked up to them and asked them if they go to church to which they said why do I care?

One of the girls told me straight up that she does not care and after questioning her where her salvation is, the entire group decided it was better to leave than interact with me. Please keep young adults in your prayers so that we could see Revival happening in this state because it starts with the youth and if we do not pray, God will not be able to prepare the soil.
#JESUS4HAYDEN

Prayer that I get moved to a better time even if I get paid less in Costco so I can be awake for evangelism, asleep when others sleep, and that I can keep going to church... I submitted paperwork to payroll, however, I still cannot come back to work due to my arms being weak. Muscles need to regrow from the atrophy. So prayer I can be restored to full healthy... I am taking a leap of faith, and keeping today's and tomorrow as Holy Days, and then pop back into work on Monday morning to see how to proceed in going back to work hopefully this leads to better opportunities

Prayer Request for Home 10/4/2026:

Praying for this household's salvation, we've placed a Bible in their library/pantry and would like to make sure Jesus opens their heart to receive the gospel.

May God have mercy on their souls.

Prayer we don't forget what God delivered us from, that we don't forget what it means to be apart from God.

I remember, I remember what I got delivered from... that empty pit in my chest and numbness, and he gave me feeling again... given over to despair and hopelessness... don't forget the Lord, like David share so you don't ever experience it again...

DONT FORGET, REFLECT AND REMEMBER WHO YOU WERE BEFORE CHRIST. THANK HIM FOR NOT BEING DEAD IN SIN.

Praise him for where you are at now. Don't forget his love. Don't forget his grace. 

All these things are gifts we were unworthy of receiving, every moment we aren't immediately dead is a gift, every heartbeat, breath, is a gift, gift, gift.

Every moment you feel an emotion of joy and hope GIFT 🎁 

DONT EVER ASK TO BE WITHOUT HIS GIFTS, HOW UNBELIEVABLY FOOLISH.

Don't take him for granted and place all your hope in him for apart from him... even for a moment... WE ARE NOTHING.

Dust, and yet, yet he hears our cries, even though we are dust... 

Just imagine... a sandcastle on the beach about to be swallowed by the waves... and then he, loving that castle dug a moat, got swallowed by that water, so we don't have to be sucked under the waves... and not only that, he placed a person to keep rebuilding our sandcastle and keep the moat working, endlessly... also we... meaningless grains of sand, do not return to the sea... 

THANK GOD, THANK YOU JESUS FOR SAVING ME!
https://open.spotify.com/track/4LklvptJ5yENts3L55ycLW?si=miEAF_iJTCeZ_714-iI23Q&utm_source=copy-link
Pray for me I keep getting spirit attacks and smarts
For smarts and other things

Prayer Request for Oksana 10/6/2026:

Oksana is the mom of Vitaliy, who is one of the very first people that appeared on my walk to encounter Jesus, or the Holy Spirit encountering me and his mom was at prayer tonight and she is having spiritual attacks that affect her physical health.

She describes it as sharp pain cutting her from within and it is actually a demonic oppression that needs to be rebuked but also need mercy from Jesus as it is not something we can help her with but only Jesus can take mercy on her from what came to my heart.

Please do pray for her.

She is a mom to our friend and someone's wife and a member of the body of Christ.

I want to pray for Ousman Darboe, and hes a guy asking for money for food, hes given me his name, and he has chatted with me. I want to pray he if he is a genuine believer he may find the food hes looking for.

Additionally, decernment for myself, because actually I still feel convicted to help.

I genuinely don't believe he's lying, then again, I have learned I can be quite gullible. So decernment that I might not be deceived.

I don't know if he's safe, but I want to send something small, I looked up the money for a meal there, if at a restaurant.

5 - 15 is enough for a meal there, and in the grand scheme of things not a big monetary loss, as I am going to be going back to work soon. And so if he isn't a believer, I am not giving him much, but for someone who genuinely needs it will genuinely help.

So yeah, prayers, and also decernment. Lastly, like reach out.

A man needs the counsel of others, to not fail. So I trust yall, what shall I do, how should I proceed

Allow the ministry to discuss this matter and determine if God will bless the finances of the ministry to give after prayer as appropriate and we are taught by Scripture

Any personal contributions you make cannot be made on behalf of the ministry and are solely your discretion to do with the finances as you please

I would caution you to have discernment in understanding if this will achieve greater good or evil long term for the non believers and their growth in faith with Jesus Christ versus single small contributions that may seem like they help now but will hurt them in the long term

Jesus4Gino(I believe thats how its spelled)

Prayer for spiritual defense for me, so I may trust and take every thought captive for the Lord. That I may endure whatever is happening to me. That my faith would be made stronger.

I am starting my shift in like ~40 mins, and I don't feel the strength or will to do this, but I also know its written I shouldn't grow tired of doing good.

I know the enemy must submit to Jesus, and things will get better.

However, right now its really hard for me.

So I will take whatever prayers you can offer me. I need every one rn 🙏
We’re praying Liam 🙌🏻🙏🏻

I pray for strength in obedience, I pray for patience, I pray for fire 🔥 for Jesus, I pray for humility in us, friends ! Pray for our ministry that we may keep serving You and our cities for You! 🌆 May Jesus fill every corner of our lives, let us not be ashamed of our God in front of our lukewarm/un believers, I rebuke the denial of Jesus but to walk with confidence and faith, He is our strength, our source, our redeemer, Lord may we walk proudly knowing we are Yours and You are ours, and keep praying for the fruits of the Spirit to grow and for You to prune our dead and unfruitful parts of our lives. 

We love you Jesus. Amen

May we pray for what we need to pray for, and remember no prayer is too big or too much for our God, Lord You bear our burdens because you care for us, You want us to reach out to You for help, for everything, You want us to depend on You, how great is our God? How wonderful and loving is He? We give You all the glory and praise Jesus our Savior 🙏🏻💕
Amen! ✊

You didn’t just die to save us from our sins, You died so we can have a bridge to You, so You could come down to us and allow us to have a true relationship with You, and give us confidence that we can do all things through You who strengthens us. May we never forget this!!! Amen and amen and amen

Jesus thank you for all you do, for calling us to be Christians, for making us more then conquers and kings and queens. With a royal inheritance into your kingdom.

You met us in the mess, and made us into saints.

Praise you for all the good you gave done, and will do. I believe you will work all things for our good.

You gave us hope, a future in a kingdom of heaven. And promised whatever suffering now is incomparable to the glory ahead of us.

Let us walk by faith, and not by sight. Renew our strength when we grow tired.

This war was won, and is ours.

The gates of hell shall not prevail against us, against this ministry, against your church, your bride.

You love us, and there is hope.

Amen and Hallelujah.

Victory is yours

I didn't get the chance to say this but we got free cookies in the break room, 😋 God really helped me through the lows.
